projectDescription: An end-to-end MLOps system that automatically classifies returned e-commerce items into five categories using a fine-tuned EfficientNet-B0 model with 96.53% accuracy, served via a containerised FastAPI inference API with batch orchestration, MLflow model versioning, and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.
keyFeatures: EfficientNet-B0 image classification with 96.53% test accuracy across 5 return categories
FastAPI inference service with Prometheus metrics and health checks
Idempotent batch orchestrator with checkpoint-based crash recovery
MLflow model registry with alias-based promotion and zero-downtime rollback
Prometheus + Grafana monitoring stack for request rates, latency, and class distribution
Streamlit UI for manual image upload, classification, and results history
Docker Compose deployment with artifact proxy via --serve-artifacts
publicApiSurface: GET /health — model service liveness and version check
BatchOrchestrator.run() — main batch inference entry point
RefundClassifier.predict() — MLflow pyfunc model prediction interface
